description: Sachplan Verkehr, Teil Infrastruktur Luftfahrt (SIL) is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Zivilluftfahrt BAZL. Der Sachplan Verkehr, Teil Infrastruktur Luftfahrt (SIL) ist das Planungs- und Koordinationsinstrument des Bundes für die zivile Luftfahrt. Er legt die Ziele und Vorgaben für die Infrastruktur der Zivilluftfahrt der Schweiz für die Behörden verbindlich fest. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Bundesamt für Zivilluftfahrt BAZL. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, GPKG, HTML, SERVICE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
